cover_letter_text:
Hi LC Water team,

I'm Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'm looking for a start as a junior civil drafter. Your ad says you design and build your own projects and you're happy to consider recent graduates, so I'd like to apply.

For the diploma I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage. Before that, on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, I went through the structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them. These days I work casually at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I live in Melton and have my own car, and I can start two weeks after an offer. I've got full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat whenever suits.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
